raw_posts.name: Product Hunt MCP
raw_posts.tagline: The community you trust in the assistant you use
raw_posts.description: Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

raw_posts.name: Dageno AI 2.0
raw_posts.tagline: See why AI recommends your competitors instead of you
raw_posts.description: AI is now choosing brands for your customers. Dageno AI is an AEO/GEO platform that shows whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and 7 more AI models recommend you or your competitors, and which sources drive those answers. Look up any market for free, forever: see top brands, buyer questions and cited sources across 12,000+ niche markets and 3M+ brands. Upgrade only when you need to track your own prompts. Built for brands and agencies.

raw_posts.name: Databox CLI
raw_posts.tagline: Your agentic analytics platform in the terminal
raw_posts.description: Create data sources, load data, build metrics, and automate workflows directly from your terminal. Use 90+ commands yourself, or let AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex do the work with 10 ready-to-use agent skills.

raw_posts.name: Arcjet AI security models
raw_posts.tagline: A family of custom-trained security models for coding agents
raw_posts.description: Arcjet is launching a family of custom AI security models designed for analyzing AI agent activity: Arcjet Himalia 1, a general purpose prompt injection model, live today for every SDK call that uses prompt injection detection, and specialist versions designed for situations that general models handle badly, Arcjet Thebe 1 for coding agents, and Arcjet Carme 1, for autonomous security agents.

raw_posts.name: Voyager
raw_posts.tagline: ✴️ An agentic file browser to navigate your work context
raw_posts.description: Voyager brings AI agents into your everyday file work on macOS. Find the files you need and work with AI agents using them as context, all within a familiar file browser. Meet a file browser built for finding your files and putting them to work with AI.

raw_posts.name: ProtoMap
raw_posts.tagline: Stop wasting AI tokens rediscovering dependencies
raw_posts.description: ProtoMap helps engineers and AI coding agents understand how services, APIs, and data fields depend on each other across large codebases. It builds a deterministic dependency map for gRPC and Protobuf systems, updated on every commit and accessible through a web app or MCP. Instead of wasting time and tokens searching code across repositories, agents query ProtoMap directly to understand change impact. One enterprise team reduced change-planning time and tokens by 8×.

raw_posts.name: MCP1
raw_posts.tagline: One URL for every MCP server.
raw_posts.description: Connect and manage all your MCP servers through a single gateway. Built by Appwrite, MCP1 lets you securely connect your AI tools, manage permissions, protect server credentials, and monitor tool usage. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, and more. Free for individuals, with dedicated plans for teams and enterprises.

raw_posts.name: Higgsfield Miracle
raw_posts.tagline: Edit any part of a video without changing the rest
raw_posts.description: Higgsfield Miracle vectorizes any video into layers for localized, pixel-level editing in real time, with world knowledge built in. Recolor objects, change backgrounds, remove or add elements, adjust lighting, and modify textures while preserving the original motion, camera, and subjects.

raw_posts.name: GitHub New PR Overview
raw_posts.tagline: See what's blocking a PR before you scroll
raw_posts.description: GitHub's new pull request overview page moves merge status to the top, with checks, approvals, comments, and next actions in one compact summary. It also adds unresolved-comment filters, newest-first sorting, and an activity panel.

raw_posts.name: Cardboard AI
raw_posts.tagline: Best way to edit videos with AI
raw_posts.description: Cardboard is an AI video editor that turns your raw clips into stories. Think of it as a creative collaborator that understands your footage, has taste to know what makes a great edit, and brings your vision to life.
